verdict.rationale: There is no documented bulk export feature. Exit paths do exist piecemeal: transcripts and recordings can be fetched via the API, raw execution data is viewable in call history, webhooks push call data to your CRM, and the CLI/MCP server manage agents and calls programmatically. The core framework is also open source and self-hostable, which lowers lock-in. Missing for 10: a documented one-shot export of all account data (agents, calls, transcripts, recordings, extractions), explicit open/standard export formats, an export of agent configurations, and independent confirmation that a migration off the platform works.
